﻿## Summary

Create a one-page public MapThru landing page at / based on the product/design brief in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-03-mapthru-landing-page-brainstorming.md.

The page should introduce MapThru as an affordable, easy-to-use PWA for AI indoor mapping from 2D floor plans. It should use the existing auth-page visual language: clean split hero, MapThru brand mark, compact confident headings, muted supporting copy, rounded icon blocks, direct CTAs, and a dark product visualization inspired by the auth visual panels.

Source Brief

  • docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-03-mapthru-landing-page-brainstorming.md
  • docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-03-mapthru-landing-page.md
  • Pricing source of truth: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1O41UmDzbGDWQNm10k2uDIRaHPNRnP9k6HJ4Cbl9Ur1Y/edit?usp=sharing

Scope

  • Replace the root / redirect with a public landing page.
  • Keep /start available as the product-start/workspace flow.
  • Add a hero section explaining MapThru clearly.
  • Add benefit cards.
  • Add AI Floor Scanner explanation.
  • Add workflow section: Upload, Scan, Edit, Preview, Publish.
  • Add TourMkr / GoThru connection section.
  • Add pricing cards for Free, Basic, and Pro.
  • Add add-on highlights.
  • Add final CTA.
  • Update SEO title and meta description.

Pricing Requirements

Use only the Google Sheet pricing.

Plans:

Plan Price Draft projects Publish projects AI Floor Scanner Export to GeoJSON
Free $0 1 project 0 projects 1 credit No
Basic $10/month or $100/year 5 projects 2 projects 5 credits/month Yes
Pro $20/month or $200/year Unlimited 10 projects 25 credits/month Yes

Add-ons:

  • Extra Publish Project: $5/month or $50/year
  • Temporary Publish Pass: $8/month or $80/year
  • 5 AI Floor Scanner Credits: $9
  • 15 AI Floor Scanner Credits: $24
  • 50 AI Floor Scanner Credits: $69
  • 150 AI Floor Scanner Credits: $179

Do not use older pricing from docs/pricing-summary.md.

Acceptance Criteria

  • / renders the public MapThru landing page, not a redirect.
  • /start remains reachable.
  • Page has one clear H1 including MapThru.
  • Hero uses auth-inspired split layout on desktop.
  • Page uses auth-page visual language, not dashboard/sidebar layout.
  • Page includes Hero, Benefits, AI Floor Scanner, Workflow, TourMkr / GoThru, Pricing, Add-ons, and Final CTA.
  • Page explains MapThru creates indoor maps from 2D floor plans.
  • Page explains AI Floor Scanner in plain language.
  • Page mentions scanning walls, doors, and windows.
  • Page explains upload, scan, edit, preview, publish.
  • Page says MapThru is a lightweight PWA.
  • Page highlights affordability and start-free path.
  • Pricing matches the Google Sheet exactly.
  • Add-ons show the six approved prices.
  • SEO title is MapThru - AI Indoor Mapping From 2D Floor Plans.
  • Meta description mentions upload, AI scan, edit, preview, publish, and indoor mapping.
  • Mobile layout has no horizontal scrolling.
  • Text does not overflow cards or buttons.
  • CTAs and navigation links are keyboard reachable.
  • No fake testimonials, fake logos, unsupported competitor claims, or named competitor comparisons.

QA Scenarios

  • Visitor opens / and immediately understands what MapThru does.
  • Visitor can click Start for free.
  • Visitor can jump to Pricing.
  • Visitor sees Free, Basic, and Pro pricing.
  • Visitor sees add-on pricing.
  • Returning user can click Sign in.
  • Mobile visitor can read every section without horizontal scrolling.
